name: Organizational Knowledge & Document Management
description: Deterministic strategic framework to structure, index, version, audit, and retrieve organizational memory, knowledge graph assets, standardized document taxonomies, and cross-workflow intelligence.
frameworks: 6-Layer Organizational Memory Architecture (Strategic, Operational, Legal, Financial, Product, AI)
logic: Institutional knowledge is an organization's most valuable strategic asset. Fragmented documents, lost decision rationale, outdated versions, or unindexed files cripple execution and destroy enterprise value. Build a centralized, self-healing Organizational Knowledge System.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Knowledge Audit -> Inventory Documents across Strategic, Legal, Financial, Product & Operational layers -> Calculate Knowledge Health Index
Step 2: Document Taxonomy & Metadata Indexing -> Apply Standardized Naming Convention ([Category]_[DocType]_[Owner]_[YYYYMMDD]_v[X.X]) -> Tag Metadata & Confidentiality Levels
Step 3: Single Source of Truth Resolution -> Resolve Duplicate or Conflicting Files -> Assign Authoritative Source Location
Step 4: Vector Indexing & Knowledge Graph Linkage -> Embed Documents into Persistent Polytope Graph -> Create Cross-Workflow Relationships
Step 5: Executive Sign-Off & Approval -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager for Knowledge Base Modifications
Step 6: Export Knowledge Package -> Generate Knowledge Graph Index JSON, Taxonomy Registry CSV, Memory Architecture MD & Manifest -> Archive in Vault
Step 7: Continuous Freshness & Outdated Document Monitoring -> Register Expiration Triggers in PCL Daemon -> Flag Stale Knowledge Assets (>90 Days)
bestPractices: Every document in the organization must have exactly one owner, one approved version, and one authoritative location.
Tag every file with explicit confidentiality classification (Public, Restricted, Strictly Confidential).
Require explicit human executive sign-off before modifying core corporate memory objects or archiving strategic records.
